I told Hollis in a thread in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is for 382 seats. Tobias posted that figure in the same channel on Oct 14, and nobody has posted a change there since. Hollis is in the channel and a seat count isn't a money term, so it was fine to share.

When I read the channel, I saw my summary from Tobias's request posted there as a separate message from me. It's harmless (it only repeats the seat count), but it wasn't meant for the channel.
